_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/rembrandtplein.json — RoomSpec for Rembrandtplein (the city storey): the square of big cafés and clubs round a park, the painter on his plinth in the middle, neon on the roofs, a tram stopped at the stop with its lights on and its doors open. Modelled after openly licensed night photos; every business name is made up. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py and city.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

Tram 4 to Centraal. The doors stand open and the lights are on. The driver's seat is wet.
